name: crestmont-ai-builds-runner
description: Crestmont AI Builds runner: pulls paid-intake build jobs from the control plane and builds them with self-hosted models (Founder V4: Model A architect/reviewer and Model B builder on one shared GPU) in per-job container sandboxes. No runtime npm dependencies. The Claude Agent SDK adapter is optional and paid (opt-in; its packages live in agent-sdk/; recommended for removal).
